title: Lemon law - federal and state boundary
facts: State lemon laws provide important new-vehicle and sometimes used-vehicle remedies, but eligibility, covered vehicles, repair attempts, time limits and procedures vary by state.
Federal warranty law, including the Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act, can provide separate consumer rights involving written warranties and service contracts.
There is no single nationwide state-style lemon-law formula that can determine every vehicle owner's remedy.
Hanka should identify the state, vehicle status and warranty facts before giving a lemon-law conclusion.
